graphics.caption: The TP73 annotated-start inventory retains all five starts and marks the P1/TAp73 row missing_flanks instead of silently padding or hiding it.

Locally computed TP73, E2F1 and PATZ1 motif-score lanes; each lane retains its own scale and score kind, so curve heights are not cross-factor rankings.

catalog.notes: Offline core walkthrough on the retained public TP73 RefSeq excerpt: recover the anchor, preview five annotated starts, retain P1 missing_flanks, approve the internal DeltaNp73 start and compute/export exact E2F1 MA0024.3, PATZ1 MA1961.2 and TP73 MA0861.2 curves. Inner Agent Assistant and explicit-state MCP/outer agents share derivation and export; GUI-hosted ui intents remain applied=false headless. Span-scoped scoring, top-three within-matrix raw positions, disclosed 128-title per-lane/strand hover cap and validated collection SVG/index/receipt export. Optional P1/P2 comparison requires an already prepared compatible reference, without implicit download or padding. Separate supplied lane scales, unavailable-not-zero bands, no occupancy or reporter claim. Retained Linux/X11 screenshots cover their recorded historical revision; new behavior, native Windows/macOS and human scientific approval remain pending.
